_comment: English text that the beta dump does not have yet. Applied by apply_en_overrides.py after gi-dm-localization:gen-file. Set and piece names are the official English ones from Lunaris (data 7.2.51, checked 2026-11-09): Epochal Advent (肇史之遗) and Empyrean Sojourn (遥天奉翠华引); the keys LegacyOfTheFirstChronicle and PreludeOfTheKingfisherCanopy still carry the provisional names chosen on 2026-11-05 (renaming them needs a database migration). Remove an entry once the dump has the official English text. Blazing Lionfang (12438): the dump has its passive only in CHS; the English below is the official text from gachabase beta 7.2.54 (2026-11-26), and the passive name fixes the dump's typo "Convenant".

lines: After the equipping character has been off-field for at least 5s, they gain the Revitalizing Spark effect: ATK is increased by {atk}. Switching them on-field while in combat will deal AoE DMG to nearby opponents equal to {dmg} of the equipping character's ATK, and this can be triggered once every 14s. The Revitalizing Spark effect will be canceled after the character has been on-field for more than 10s.
